verses.text: Then I looked again and saw all the cruelty that is done under the sun. Look, I saw the tears of people who were treated cruelly, and they had no one to comfort them. Their oppressors had power, but those who suffered had no one to comfort them.
So I said the dead, who died long ago, are better off than the living who are still alive.
Yes, better than both of them is the one who has not yet been born, who has not seen the evil that is done under the sun.
Then I saw that all hard work and success come from people being jealous of their neighbors. This too is meaningless, like chasing the wind.
The fool folds their hands and does nothing, and ruins themselves.
Better one handful with peace and quiet than two handfuls with hard work and chasing the wind.
Then I looked again and saw something else meaningless under the sun.

There is a person who is all alone, with no son or brother. There is no end to all their hard work, and their eyes are never satisfied with riches. They never ask, "Who am I working for, and why am I keeping myself from enjoying life?" This too is meaningless. Yes, it is a sad business.
Two are better than one, because they get a good reward for their work.
If one of them falls, the other can help them up. But pity the person who is alone when they fall, with no one to help them up.
Also, if two lie down together, they keep warm. But how can one keep warm alone?
Someone may overpower a person who is alone, but two can stand up against them. And a rope made of three strands is not quickly broken.
A poor but wise young person is better than an old and foolish king who no longer listens to advice.
For the young person came out of prison to become king, even though he was born poor in that kingdom.
I saw all the people who live under the sun follow the young person, the one who took the king's place.
There was no end to all the people he led. Yet those who come later will not be happy with him. Surely this too is meaningless, like chasing the wind.
